name: realtor-riverside-editor
displayName: The AI Editing Studio - Riverside or Instagram Edits engine (Plugin 10)
description: The AI Editing Studio: a full-time video editor inside the agent's Claude, on the engine they choose: their Riverside account (records, edits, publishes; any Claude surface) or Instagram's free Edits app for Mac (driven from Claude Code on their Mac; no per-edit fees). 28 skills across five stages: DIRECT (creative direction, record coach, transcript read, section map), CUT (remove the fluff, hook finder, rescue cut, interview edit), POLISH (audio enhance, color and look with a measured Adjust-panel grade, captions, music with a measured audition, B-roll, B-roll library, brand graphics with icons, energy), REPURPOSE (short-form repurpose, weekly batch, podcast, trailer), SHIP (quality check, review and revise, publish), plus setup, a plain-English navigator that resumes any stopped edit, and full recipes (long-form, reel, listing). Every change is verified: revision diffs on Riverside, rendered frames and the exported file on Edits. Publishing only on an explicit yes (Riverside); Edits exports and the agent shares. One owner per output: it never writes titles, descriptions, chapter names, post captions, or designs. Requires Plugin 1 (the Brain) and either a Riverside Grow plan or a Mac with Edits.
